summary: Cybin Inc. (filer) filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its participation at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The release notes Eric So as Interim CEO but the role is not newly forced; it appears pre-existing. This is a routine investor-relations announcement. Therefore, the filing does not constitute a special situation.
